svg.title: fig item lookup
svg.desc:
Caller asks Service to get an item. Service asks Store to read it. Store replies to Service, then Service replies to Caller. Requests are solid and replies dashed; time flows downward.
Source (mermaid): sequenceDiagram participant Caller participant Service participant Store Caller->>Service: Get item Service->>Store: Read item Store-->>Service: Item Service-->>Caller: Item
